description: Find Microsoft accounts by email address, full name or email domain, or look one up by CID. A name search matches the whole name; use * as a wildcard for a partial name. Costs 1 credit (or one of a pack's free daily tool searches); finding nothing or failing costs nothing.

include_raw.description: Return everything each source sent instead of the main fields. Much longer; off by default.

max_wait_seconds.description: Seconds to wait before returning what has arrived so far (default 50). The tool keeps running on OSINT.SX after that, so its credit may still be used.

query.description: The email, name, domain or CID.

name: microsoft_account_lookup
title: Microsoft account lookup
